content.comment_body: Hello, I am experiencing difficulty setting up communication between a [product_name] with [version_no] and a Beijer HMI X2 Pro. Both devices have IP addresses within the same class, but they still cannot connect. What gateway address should I input on the Beijer interface? Additionally, in ix developer, I have tried selecting two types of controllers (TCP/ISO, HMI adapter), but neither option worked. Any suggestions are appreciated. Thank you.

Both the [product_name] and the HMI need to be configured within the same IP subnet, for example: 192.168.178.x. Example configuration: [product_name] = 192.168.178.10, HMI = 192.168.178.11. Ensure the subnet mask is identical for both devices, such as 255.255.255.0. In this case, there is no need to enter a gateway IP address. The [product_name] with [version_no] communicates via TCP/IP using the S7 protocol.

analysis.insight_summary: Users report trouble establishing connectivity between a [product_name] and a Beijer HMI, mainly due to IP settings and protocol compatibility. There is uncertainty around network parameters such as gateway and controller selection, revealing gaps in setup knowledge and a need for more comprehensive integration guidelines.
analysis.user_expectations: The user expects a simple and intuitive network setup process, along with automatic device recognition between the [product_name] and the Beijer HMI. Clear instructions regarding gateway configuration and controller protocol choices in third-party HMI applications are desired.
